            '// ══ [bench 2026-09-24] 官方配置的喂料口径(台架默认)══════════════════════════════\n'
            '// 官方 iOS demo:AVCapture `.vga640x480` @30 fps,`presentationTimeStamp` 原样推,yaml\n'
            '// `time_offset: 0.0`。台架照这个口径喂同一个引擎(官方规则 + 线程化的那条臂):\n'
            '//   ① 相机准入 30 Hz —— 形状抄生产 `PwVioSlamFeeder.enqueue(frame:)`:\n'
            '//      `t − t_上一次准入 < 门限` 就不收(对原始时间戳判,在有界闸之前)。\n'
            '//      门限 = 0.8/R,不是生产的 1/R:直播相机本身就定在 30 fps(上游 setFps(30)),\n'
            '//      帧间隔 33.33 ms ± 抖动,1/R 会把一半「略短于 33.333 ms」的帧挡掉、实际只剩 ~20 Hz。\n'
            '//      0.8/R 对 60 Hz 源(ARKit 录制)照样隔帧取(16.7 挡、33.3 收),对 30 Hz 源全收,\n'
            '//      对 120 Hz 源取每 4 帧一帧。三段 ARKit 录制上与生产 1/R 规则只差 1 帧/段,\n'
            '//      Mac 回放已用同一门限重跑(xrofficial 报告)。\n'
            '//      启动参数 `-PWXrslamCameraHz <R>`,默认 30;0 = 不设准入(旧行为)。\n'
            '//   ② 分辨率跟 device yaml 走:源帧宽高恰是 yaml `cam0.resolution` 的整数 n 倍(n>1)\n'
            '//      ⇒ 先转灰度(BGRA 用与 OpenCV `COLOR_BGRA2GRAY` 逐位相同的定点系数),再\n'
            '//      `PWXrslamTransportPrepareGrayBoxNxN` 做 box n×n,推 channel 1;逐帧 K 走\n'
            '//      `PWXrslamTransportScaleIntrinsicsForBoxNxN`。n 由 Dart 写 yaml 决定,原生只照做。\n'
            '//      相等 ⇒ 原样推(旧行为)。\n'
            '//   ③ 时间戳:[bench 2026-09-25 起] **默认曝光中点**(文件头偏离 (d)),不再是官方的原始 PTS。\n'
            '//      规则 `t_feed = PTS + exposure/2 + c`,c ≈ readout/2(Huai arXiv 2001.00470 §IV.B,09-22 定案):\n'
            '//      帧时间戳是曝光**起点**,而画面内容对应曝光**中点**;exposure/2 在这里逐帧加,\n'
            '//      c 由调用方按每机查表传进 create(`camera_time_offset.dart`,iPhone15,2 = 3.00 ms,\n'
            '//      直播页 / 回放页在本开关为 on 时查表,为 off 时用官方 0)。\n'
            '//      证据(真机回放 run-13f53d2f,on + c=2.65 ms):XRSLAM/ARKit 0.963 → 1.0022,ATE 5.4 → 1.79 cm;\n'
            '//      run-fb5d3a8f 前 17.8 s:1.0089 / 0.71 cm。3.00 与 2.65 之差 0.35 ms 落在实测最优平台\n'
            '//      (总偏移 +8…+12 ms)之内。\n'
            '//      退回官方原始 PTS:启动参数 `-PWXrslamExposureMid off`(Dart 侧同时把 c 默认回 0)。\n'
            '//      🔴 30 Hz 准入 ① 与台架 LiDAR 录制器(bench-only ruler)都只看**原始** PTS,不受本开关影响;\n'
            '//         回放按录制帧键控也用原始 PTS 的位模式(PwBenchReplay.observe)。\n'
            'enum PwXrslamOfficialFeed {\n'
            '    /// 曝光中点开关的台架默认值(2026-09-25 起为 on)。\n'
            '    static let kExposureMidDefault = true\n'
            '\n'
            '    struct Resolved {\n'
            '        let cameraHz: Double\n'
            '        let exposureMid: Bool\n'
            '        let rawHz: String\n'
            '        let rawExposure: String\n'
            '        /// "default"(没传参数)/ "launch_argument" / "unparseable"(传了但解析不了 ⇒ 留在默认)。\n'
            '        let exposureMidSource: String\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    private static func launchValue(_ key: String) -> String {\n'
            '        if let v = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: key), !v.isEmpty { return v }\n'
            '        let args = ProcessInfo.processInfo.arguments\n'
            '        if let i = args.firstIndex(of: "-\\(key)"), i + 1 < args.count { return args[i + 1] }\n'
            '        return ""\n'

            '\n'
            '    static let resolved: Resolved = {\n'
            '        let rh = launchValue("PWXrslamCameraHz")\n'
            '        let re = launchValue("PWXrslamExposureMid")\n'

            '        let e = re.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()\n'

            '        var src = "default"\n'

            '\n'
            '    /// [bench 2026-09-24 rec30] 准入闸 ① 的**唯一**实现,`onCameraFrame` 与台架录制器\n'
            '    /// (PwBenchLidarSession,🔴 bench-only ruler)都调它 ⇒ 录制时挑的 30 Hz 帧与回放时引擎收的帧\n'
            '    /// 是同一条式子、同一组 Double 运算挑出来的。`ptsSeconds` 必须是回放推给引擎的那个值:\n'
            '    /// `Double(t_ns) * 1e-9`(PwBenchReplay.swift 投递处),录制器按同一式子从整数纳秒换回。\n'
            '    /// 返回 true = 收;调用方收下后把 `ptsSeconds` 记成新的 lastAdmitted。\n'
            '    /// 幂等:一串已经过闸的时间戳(相邻 ≥ 0.8/R)再过一次闸,全收 —— 录制按 30 Hz 落盘后,\n'
            '    /// 回放时的同一道闸不会再挡掉任何一帧,与从哪一帧开始喂无关。\n'
            '    @inline(__always)\n'
            '    static func admits(ptsSeconds: Double, lastAdmittedPts: Double, haveAdmitted: Bool,\n'
            '                       cameraHz: Double) -> Bool {\n'
            '        guard cameraHz > 0 else { return true }\n'
            '        return !(haveAdmitted && ptsSeconds - lastAdmittedPts < 0.8 / cameraHz)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            '/// [pw 2026-09-23 复核修正] 一帧「用的是哪份 K」的标签。两条原生通路共用,\n'
            '/// 与 Dart `XrslamLiveIntrinsics.lastSourceLabel` 一一对应。\n'
            '///   config                         没推逐帧 K ⇒ yaml 常量\n'
            '///   per_frame                      推了,且构建身份 = 认逐帧 K 的臂,且回读没有反证\n'
            '///   per_frame_not_consumed         推了,但回读 ≠ 推的值(核没收下),或构建身份 = 不认的臂\n'
            '///   per_frame_attached_unverified  推了,回读相等,但没有构建身份可核(相等不算证据)\n'
            'enum PwPerFrameIntrinsicsSource: Int {\n'
            '    case none = 0, config = 1, perFrame = 2, perFrameNotConsumed = 3,\n'
            '         perFrameAttachedUnverified = 4\n'
            '\n'
            '    var label: String {\n'
            '        switch self {\n'
            '        case .none: return "none"\n'
            '        case .config: return "config"\n'
            '        case .perFrame: return "per_frame"\n'

            '\n'
            '/// [pw 2026-09-23 复核修正] 引擎按 yaml 的 `cam0.resolution` 包 cv::Mat\n'
            '/// (fork 04c0e83 `XRSLAMManager.cpp:143-144` `config_->camera_resolution()`,\n'
            '/// 键名 `yaml_config.cpp:177` `cam0.resolution`)。推的缓冲不是这个尺寸时,\n'
            '/// 引擎看到的不是整帧,逐帧 K 的参照就对不上 ⇒ 不推逐帧 K。\n'
            '/// 读的是**引擎自己要读的那个文件**;格式是 Dart `XrslamConfigBuilder.buildDeviceConfigYaml`\n'
            '/// (`lib/vio/ffi/xrslam_config.dart` 的 `  resolution: [ W, H ]`,`cam0:` 下两格缩进)写的,\n'
            '/// 这条格式由 `test/vio/ffi/per_frame_intrinsics_host_contract_test.dart` 钉住。\n'
            '/// 解析不出来 ⇒ `nil`(不推逐帧 K,按原因计数,不猜)。\n'
            'enum PwXrslamDeviceYaml {\n'
            '    static func cam0Resolution(atPath path: String) -> (width: Int, height: Int)? {\n'
            '        guard let text = try? String(contentsOfFile: path, encoding: .utf8) else { return nil }\n'
            '        var inCam0 = false\n'
            '        var found: (Int, Int)? = nil\n'
            '        for rawLine in text.components(separatedBy: .newlines) {\n'
            '            let line = rawLine.replacingOccurrences(of: "\\r", with: "")\n'
            '            if let first = line.first, first != " ", first != "#", first != "%" {\n'
            '                inCam0 = (line.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) == "cam0:")\n'
            '                continue\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            guard inCam0, line.hasPrefix("  resolution:") else { continue }\n'
            '            let body = line.dropFirst("  resolution:".count)\n'
            '                .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)\n'
            '            guard body.hasPrefix("["), let close = body.firstIndex(of: "]") else { return nil }\n'
            '            let inner = body[body.index(after: body.startIndex)..<close]\n'
            '            let parts = inner.split(separator: ",").map {\n'
            '                $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            guard parts.count == 2, let w = Int(parts[0]), let h = Int(parts[1]),\n'
            '                  w > 0, h > 0 else { return nil }\n'
            '            if found != nil { return nil }  // 出现两次 ⇒ 不猜是哪一个\n'
            '            found = (w, h)\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        guard let f = found else { return nil }\n'
            '        return (width: f.0, height: f.1)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '}\n'

            'final class PwXrslamLive {\n'

            '    /// 而"IMU 必须与相机共用同一个串行上下文"这条不变量由 `begin()` 强制\n'
            '    /// (没登记就返回 -4,不会静默退化成两条独立队列)。\n'
            '    private var serialQueue: DispatchQueue?\n'

            '    private var cameraLockFailures: UInt64 = 0\n'

            '    // ── 有界入队 + 串行 worker(抄生产 PwVioSlamFeeder)────────────────────\n'
            '    /// 算法只在这条队列上跑。回调**绝不**在这里等。\n'
            '    private let workQueue = DispatchQueue(\n'
            '        label: "com.pocketworld.xrslam.live.work", qos: .userInitiated)\n'
            '\n'
            '    /// 相机在途帧数上限。取 2:一帧在算、一帧在等。\n'
            '    /// 🔴 不能大 —— 每一帧都 retain 着一个 AVFoundation 池里的\n'
            '    ///    `CVPixelBuffer`(1920×1440 BGRA ≈ 11 MB)。押太多帧,采集端会\n'
            '    ///    `out_of_buffers`,那是把丢帧从我们的闸上推回给系统,归因就没了。\n'
            '    private static let maxPendingFrames = 2\n'
            '    /// IMU 在途上限。100 Hz × 4 s —— 只在 worker 被长时间占住时才会命中。\n'
            '    private static let maxPendingImu = 400\n'
            '\n'

            '\n'
            '    private func onGyro(_ data: CMGyroData) {\n'
            '        // 🔴 陀螺 x/y/z **原样透传不换算**(上游 Motion.swift:47 就是原值),\n'
            '        //    时间戳用**这条样本自己的** `data.timestamp`。\n'
            '        let t = data.timestamp\n'
            '        let r = data.rotationRate\n'
            '        lock.lock(); lastImuTs = t; lock.unlock()\n'
            '        enqueueImu { _ = PWXrslamTransportPushGyroscopeRaw(t, r.x, r.y, r.z) }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    private func onAccel(_ data: CMAccelerometerData) {\n'
            '        // 🔴 **常数是负的**:上游 `Motion.swift:3` `GRAVITY_NOMINAL = -9.80665`,\n'
            '        //    并在 `Motion.swift:56` 直接乘上去。符号反了重力方向整个反过来。\n'
            '        let g = -9.80665\n'
            '        let t = data.timestamp\n'
            '        let a = data.acceleration\n'
            '        enqueueImu {\n'
            '            _ = PWXrslamTransportPushAccelerationRaw(\n'
            '                t, a.x * g, a.y * g, a.z * g)\n'
            '        }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    /// 由 `PwCameraSlot` 的 `captureOutput` 调用。\n'
            '    ///\n'
            '    /// 🔴 **只入队,不跑算法**(生产 `PwVioSlamFeeder.swift:9`:\n'
            '    ///    "回调只尝试有界入队,绝不等算法")。在途满了就**计数丢弃**并立刻\n'
            '    ///    返回 —— 让相机继续按自己的节奏交付,而不是被算法拖成 12 fps。\n'
            '    /// [ptsSeconds] 是**原始** presentationTimeStamp(曝光起点);[exposureSeconds]\n'
            '    /// 是当帧曝光时长(0 = 未知)。这里换算到曝光中点再推(文件头偏离 (d))。\n'
            '    /// [intrinsics] = 这一帧 sample buffer 自带的 K(`nil` = 这一帧没有附件)。\n'
            '    ///   跟着这一帧进 worker,**不**从共享状态里再读 —— 否则算的是 A 帧、用的是 B 帧的 K。\n'
            '    func onCameraFrame(_ pixelBuffer: CVPixelBuffer, ptsSeconds: Double,\n'
            '                       exposureSeconds: Double,\n'
            '                       intrinsics: PwFrameIntrinsics? = nil) {\n'
            '        // 曝光中点换算。exposure 非法/未知按 0:等价于"没换算",并计数暴露出来。\n'
            '        let exposure = (exposureSeconds.isFinite && exposureSeconds >= 0)\n'
            '            ? exposureSeconds : 0\n'
            '        // [bench 2026-09-25] 默认曝光中点 (d):t_feed = PTS + exposure/2 + c(c 由传输层加);\n'
            '        //   -PWXrslamExposureMid off 退回官方原始 PTS。准入闸与回放键控仍用原始 ptsSeconds。\n'
            '        let feed = PwXrslamOfficialFeed.resolved\n'
            '        let half = feed.exposureMid ? 0.5 * exposure : 0\n'
            '        let canonical = ptsSeconds + half\n'
            '\n'
            '        lock.lock()\n'
            '        guard running else { lock.unlock(); return }\n'
            '        // [bench 2026-09-24] 30 Hz 准入(生产 PwVioSlamFeeder 的形状,门限 0.8/R,见 PwXrslamOfficialFeed)。\n'
            '        if feed.cameraHz > 0 {\n'
            '            if !PwXrslamOfficialFeed.admits(ptsSeconds: ptsSeconds, lastAdmittedPts: feedLastAdmittedPts,\n'
            '                                            haveAdmitted: feedHaveAdmitted, cameraHz: feed.cameraHz) {\n'
            '                feedRateSampledOut &+= 1\n'
            '                lock.unlock()\n'
            '                return\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            feedHaveAdmitted = true\n'
            '            feedLastAdmittedPts = ptsSeconds\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        framesOffered &+= 1\n'
            '        lastCameraPts = ptsSeconds   // 保持原始 PTS:timing() 比的是时钟域,不是换算\n'
            '        lastCanonicalPts = canonical\n'
            '        tbFrames &+= 1\n'
            '        if exposure > 0 {\n'
            '            tbFramesWithExposure &+= 1\n'
            '            tbExposureSum += exposure\n'
            '            if exposure < tbExposureMin { tbExposureMin = exposure }\n'
            '            if exposure > tbExposureMax { tbExposureMax = exposure }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        tbHalfAppliedSum += half\n'
            '        if lastImuTs > 0 {\n'
            '            lastDelta = ptsSeconds - lastImuTs\n'
            '            haveDelta = true\n'
            '            if abs(lastDelta) > maxAbsDelta { maxAbsDelta = abs(lastDelta) }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if pendingFrames >= Self.maxPendingFrames {\n'
            '            framesDropped &+= 1\n'
            '            lock.unlock()\n'
            '            return\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        pendingFrames += 1\n'
            '        if pendingFrames > maxObservedPendingFrames {\n'
            '            maxObservedPendingFrames = pendingFrames\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-23 台架回放] 只有装了观察者才取入队时刻(直播恒 nil ⇒ 不取)。\n'
            '        let observed = frameObserver != nil\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        let enqueuedAtNs: UInt64 = observed ? DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds : 0\n'
            '\n'
            '        // `CVPixelBuffer` 是 CF 桥接类型,捕获进闭包即 retain、闭包销毁即\n'
            '        // release —— 池里的这一格在 worker 用完之前不会被覆盖。\n'
            '        workQueue.async { [weak self] in\n'
            '            self?.runOneFrame(pixelBuffer, canonical: canonical, rawPts: ptsSeconds,\n'
            '                              intrinsics: intrinsics, enqueuedAtNs: enqueuedAtNs)\n'
            '        }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    /// 在 worker 上跑。与上游 `trackCamera`(`XRSLAM_iOS.mm:152-188`)同形:\n'
            '    /// push → RunOneFrame → GetResult 由传输层一次原子做完。\n'
            '    private func runOneFrame(_ pixelBuffer: CVPixelBuffer, canonical: Double,\n'
            '                             rawPts: Double, intrinsics: PwFrameIntrinsics?,\n'
            '                             enqueuedAtNs: UInt64 = 0) {\n'
            '        defer {\n'
            '            lock.lock(); pendingFrames -= 1; lock.unlock()\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        let startedAtNs: UInt64 = enqueuedAtNs != 0 ? DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds : 0\n'
            '        guard CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(pixelBuffer, .readOnly) == kCVReturnSuccess\n'
            '        else {\n'
            '            lock.lock(); cameraLockFailures &+= 1; lock.unlock()\n'
            '            return\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        defer { CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(pixelBuffer, .readOnly) }\n'
            '        guard let srcBase = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddress(pixelBuffer) else { return }\n'
            '        let srcStride = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRow(pixelBuffer)\n'
            '        let sourceWidth = CVPixelBufferGetWidth(pixelBuffer)\n'
            '        let sourceHeight = CVPixelBufferGetHeight(pixelBuffer)\n'
            '        let isGray =\n'
            '            CVPixelBufferGetPixelFormatType(pixelBuffer) == kCVPixelFormatType_OneComponent8\n'
            '\n'
            '        // [bench 2026-09-24] 官方喂料 ②:源尺寸恰是 yaml cam0.resolution 的 n 倍(n>1)⇒ box n。\n'
            '        lock.lock()\n'
            '        let cfgRes = ikConfigResolution\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        var factor = 1\n'
            '        if let c = cfgRes, c.width > 0, c.height > 0,\n'
            '           sourceWidth % c.width == 0, sourceHeight % c.height == 0,\n'
            '           sourceWidth / c.width == sourceHeight / c.height, sourceWidth / c.width > 1 {\n'
            '            factor = sourceWidth / c.width\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        var base = UnsafeMutableRawPointer(srcBase)\n'
            '        var stride = srcStride\n'
            '        var pushedWidth = sourceWidth\n'
            '        var pushedHeight = sourceHeight\n'
            '        var boxed = false\n'
            '        if factor > 1 {\n'
            '            // 灰度源:ARKit/录制的 Y 平面原样;BGRA:与 OpenCV COLOR_BGRA2GRAY 同一组定点系数\n'
            '            // (B 1868 / G 9617 / R 4899,>>14,+8192 取整),逐位等于引擎自己那次 cvtColor。\n'
            '            var grayPtr: UnsafePointer<UInt8>? = nil\n'
            '            var grayStride = 0\n'
            '            if isGray {\n'
            '                grayPtr = UnsafePointer(srcBase.assumingMemoryBound(to: UInt8.self))\n'
            '                grayStride = srcStride\n'
            '            } else if CVPixelBufferGetPixelFormatType(pixelBuffer) == kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA {\n'
            '                let need = sourceWidth * sourceHeight\n'
            '                if feedGrayCapacity < need {\n'
            '                    feedGrayScratch?.deallocate()\n'
            '                    feedGrayScratch = UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>.allocate(capacity: need)\n'
            '                    feedGrayCapacity = need\n'
            '                }\n'
            '                var src = vImage_Buffer(data: srcBase, height: vImagePixelCount(sourceHeight),\n'
            '                                        width: vImagePixelCount(sourceWidth), rowBytes: srcStride)\n'
            '                var dst = vImage_Buffer(data: UnsafeMutableRawPointer(feedGrayScratch), height: vImagePixelCount(sourceHeight),\n'
            '                                        width: vImagePixelCount(sourceWidth), rowBytes: sourceWidth)\n'
            '                let m: [Int16] = [1868, 9617, 4899, 0]   // 内存序 B G R A\n'
            '                let e = vImageMatrixMultiply_ARGB8888ToPlanar8(\n'
            '                    &src, &dst, m, 16384, nil, 8192, vImage_Flags(kvImageNoFlags))\n'
            '                if e == kvImageNoError {\n'
            '                    grayPtr = UnsafePointer(feedGrayScratch!)\n'
            '                    grayStride = sourceWidth\n'
            '                }\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            let outW = sourceWidth / factor, outH = sourceHeight / factor\n'
            '            if feedBoxCapacity < outW * outH {\n'
            '                feedBoxScratch?.deallocate()\n'
            '                feedBoxScratch = UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>.allocate(capacity: outW * outH)\n'
            '                feedBoxCapacity = outW * outH\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            var w: Int32 = 0, h: Int32 = 0\n'
            '            let brc: Int32 = grayPtr.map {\n'
            '                PWXrslamTransportPrepareGrayBoxNxN(\n'
            '                    $0, Int32(sourceWidth), Int32(sourceHeight), Int32(grayStride),\n'
            '                    Int32(factor), feedBoxScratch, Int32(feedBoxCapacity), &w, &h)\n'
            '            } ?? -1\n'
            '            guard brc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue, Int(w) == outW, Int(h) == outH else {\n'
            '                lock.lock(); feedBoxFailures &+= 1; lock.unlock()\n'
            '                return\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            base = UnsafeMutableRawPointer(feedBoxScratch!)\n'
            '            stride = outW\n'
            '            pushedWidth = outW\n'
            '            pushedHeight = outH\n'
            '            boxed = true\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        lock.lock()\n'
            '        feedLastSourceWidth = sourceWidth; feedLastSourceHeight = sourceHeight\n'
            '        feedLastFactor = factor\n'
            '        if boxed { feedBoxedFrames &+= 1 }\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-23] 这一帧推不推自己的 K(文件头「逐帧内参」段)。\n'
            '        //   整帧直推、不降采样 ⇒ K 原值即推送像素上的 K,不做任何算术。\n'
            '        //   参照尺寸对不上就退回 yaml 常量并计数 —— 不猜换算。\n'
            '        //   [复核修正] 还要核「推送尺寸 == 引擎 yaml 的 cam0.resolution」:引擎按 yaml\n'
            '        //   尺寸包 cv::Mat(fork XRSLAMManager.cpp:143-144),不等时它看到的不是这整帧\n'
            '        //   (例如显式传了更小的 feedWidth,`zero_arkit_capture_runtime.dart` 构造参数)。\n'
            '        //   上面两组尺寸都取自同一个 sample buffer,本来就相等;真正要核的是这一组。\n'
            '        lock.lock()\n'
            '        let configResolution = ikConfigResolution\n'
            '        let observer = frameObserver   // [pw 2026-09-23 台架回放] 直播恒 nil\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        var frameK: [Double]? = nil\n'
            '        // 0 推;1 开关 off;2 无附件;3 参照≠推送;4 activeFormat≠推送;\n'
            '        // 5 yaml cam0.resolution≠推送;6 yaml 里读不出 cam0.resolution\n'
            '        var hostReason = 0\n'
            '        if !PwPerFrameIntrinsicsSwitch.resolved.enabled {\n'
            '            hostReason = 1\n'
            '        } else if configResolution == nil {\n'
            '            hostReason = 6\n'
            '        } else if let cfg = configResolution,\n'
            '                  cfg.width != pushedWidth || cfg.height != pushedHeight {\n'
            '            hostReason = 5\n'
            '        } else if let k = intrinsics {\n'
            '            // [bench 2026-09-24] 参照尺寸对的是**源帧**;box 之后 K 用传输层同一公式换算。\n'
            '            if k.referenceWidth != sourceWidth || k.referenceHeight != sourceHeight {\n'
            '                hostReason = 3\n'
            '            } else if k.activeFormatWidth != sourceWidth\n'
            '                        || k.activeFormatHeight != sourceHeight {\n'
            '                hostReason = 4\n'
            '            } else if factor > 1 {\n'
            '                var src = [k.fx, k.fy, k.cx, k.cy]\n'
            '                var dst = [Double](repeating: 0, count: 4)\n'
            '                let krc = PWXrslamTransportScaleIntrinsicsForBoxNxN(&src, Int32(factor), &dst)\n'
            '                if krc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue { frameK = dst } else { hostReason = 3 }\n'
            '            } else {\n'
            '                frameK = [k.fx, k.fy, k.cx, k.cy]\n'
            '            }\n'
            '        } else {\n'
            '            hostReason = 2\n'
            '        }\n'
            '\n'
            '        var state: Int32 = 0\n'
            '        var pose = PWXrslamRawPose()\n'
            '        // channel = 4:BGRA 直推,引擎内部转灰度(见文件头偏离 (b))。\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-23 台架回放] 通道数跟着像素格式走:台架回放推的是录制里的\n'
            '        //   luma 平面(OneComponent8 ⇒ 1,与 `PwVioSlamFeeder.swift:1701` 推灰度用的\n'
            '        //   同一个值;引擎 channel==1 分支原样 clone,fork XRSLAMManager.cpp:167-169)。\n'
            '        //   直播相机槽恒为 32BGRA ⇒ 仍是 4,与改动前逐字相同。\n'
            '        let channel: Int32 = (boxed || isGray) ? 1 : 4\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-23 台架回放] 只有装了观察者才计时(直播恒 nil ⇒ 不取时钟)。\n'
            '        let timed = observer != nil\n'
            '        let wall0: UInt64 = timed ? DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds : 0\n'
            '        let cpu0: UInt64 = timed ? clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID) : 0\n'
            '        let rc: Int32\n'
            '        if let k = frameK {\n'
            '            rc = k.withUnsafeBufferPointer { kp in\n'
            '                PWXrslamTransportPushCameraAndRunRawWithIntrinsics(\n'
            '                    base.assumingMemoryBound(to: UInt8.self),\n'
            '                    canonical, Int32(stride), /*camera_id=*/0, channel,\n'
            '                    kp.baseAddress, &state, &pose)\n'
            '            }\n'
            '        } else {\n'
            '            rc = PWXrslamTransportPushCameraAndRunRaw(\n'
            '                base.assumingMemoryBound(to: UInt8.self),\n'
            '                canonical, Int32(stride), /*camera_id=*/0, channel,\n'
            '                &state, &pose)\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        let wall1: UInt64 = timed ? DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds : 0\n'
            '        let cpu1: UInt64 = timed ? clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID) : 0\n'
            '\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-22] 时基自证(文件头偏离 (d)):刚推完就读 C 账本里相机流的\n'
            '        //   最近一条 trace。workQueue 是串行的、只有这里推相机 ⇒ 读到的必是本帧。\n'
            '        //   `tr.stream` 的内容校验不依赖返回码语义。\n'
            '        var tr = PWXrslamTimestampTrace()\n'
            '        let trc = PWXrslamTransportGetLastTimestampTrace(\n'
            '            Int32(PW_XRSLAM_STREAM_CAMERA.rawValue), &tr)\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-23] 逐帧内参的 C 账本:同一条串行 worker、只有这里推相机\n'
            '        //   ⇒ 读到的是本帧;仍用 camera submitted_sequence 对一次账。\n'
            '        var observedIk = PWXrslamIntrinsicsTrace()   // [台架回放] 交给观察者的本帧账\n'
            '        var observedIkOk = false\n'
            '        var observedSource = 0\n'
            '        if rc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue {\n'
            '            var ik = PWXrslamIntrinsicsTrace()\n'
            '            let ikrc = PWXrslamTransportGetIntrinsicsTrace(&ik)\n'
            '            if ikrc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue { observedIk = ik; observedIkOk = true }\n'
            '            lock.lock()\n'
            '            ikFrames &+= 1\n'
            '            ikLastPushedWidth = pushedWidth\n'
            '            ikLastPushedHeight = pushedHeight\n'
            '            switch hostReason {\n'
            '            case 1: ikSwitchOff &+= 1\n'
            '            case 2: ikNoAttachment &+= 1\n'
            '            case 3: ikReferenceMismatch &+= 1\n'
            '            case 4: ikActiveFormatMismatch &+= 1\n'
            '            case 5: ikConfigResolutionMismatch &+= 1\n'
            '            case 6: ikConfigResolutionUnknown &+= 1\n'
            '            default: break\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            if ikrc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue {\n'
            '                ikTrace = ik\n'
            '                if trc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue,\n'
            '                   ik.camera_submitted_sequence != tr.submitted_sequence {\n'
            '                    ikTraceSequenceMismatch &+= 1\n'
            '                }\n'
            '                // [复核修正] 回读相等**不算**「引擎吃到」;见 PwPerFrameIntrinsicsSource。\n'
            '                ikLastSource = PwPerFrameIntrinsicsSource.classify(\n'
            '                    attached: ik.last_per_frame_attached == 1,\n'
            '                    engineReportDiffers: ik.last_engine_report_differs == 1).rawValue\n'
            '                observedSource = ikLastSource\n'
            '                if ik.last_per_frame_attached == 1 {\n'
            '                    let fx = ik.last_attached_fxfycxcy.0\n'
            '                    if fx < ikFxMin { ikFxMin = fx }\n'
            '                    if fx > ikFxMax { ikFxMax = fx }\n'
            '                }\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            lock.unlock()\n'
            '        }\n'
            '\n'
            '        if trc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue,\n'
            '           tr.stream == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_STREAM_CAMERA.rawValue) {\n'
            '            let rRaw = abs(tr.raw_timestamp - canonical)\n'
            '            let rOff = abs((tr.effective_timestamp - tr.raw_timestamp) - tr.applied_offset)\n'
            '            lock.lock()\n'
            '            tbTraceReads &+= 1\n'
            '            tbLastAppliedOffset = tr.applied_offset\n'
            '            tbLastEffectiveMinusPts = tr.effective_timestamp - rawPts\n'
            '            if rRaw > tbMaxAbsRawResidual { tbMaxAbsRawResidual = rRaw }\n'
            '            if rOff > tbMaxAbsOffsetResidual { tbMaxAbsOffsetResidual = rOff }\n'
            '            lock.unlock()\n'
            '        }\n'
            '\n'
            '        lock.lock()\n'
            '        cameraCallbacks &+= 1\n'
            '        if rc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue {\n'
            '            lastState = state\n'
            '            // 🔴 只有 TRACKING_SUCCESS 才更新位姿 —— 抄上游 XRSLAM_iOS.mm:171\n'
            '            //    `if (result == XRSLAM_STATE_TRACKING_SUCCESS)`,其余状态下\n'
            '            //    引擎返回的是陈旧/未定义值。\n'
            '            if state == 1 {\n'
            '                lastPose = pose\n'
            '                haveResult = true\n'
            '            }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '        // [pw 2026-09-23 台架回放] 逐帧观察者(直播恒 nil)。在 worker 上、本帧的\n'
            '        //   pendingFrames 递减之前调用 ⇒ 回放器看到「在途 = 0」时,所有帧的记录都已交出。\n'
            '        if let observer {\n'
            '            observer(PwXrslamFrameObservation(\n'
            '                rc: rc,\n'
            '                state: rc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue ? state : 0,\n'
            '                pose: pose,\n'
            '                rawPts: rawPts,\n'
            '                canonical: canonical,\n'
            '                traceOk: trc == PW_XRSLAM_OK.rawValue\n'
            '                    && tr.stream == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_STREAM_CAMERA.rawValue),\n'
            '                submittedSequence: tr.submitted_sequence,\n'
            '                effectiveTimestamp: tr.effective_timestamp,\n'
            '                channel: channel,\n'
            '                pushedWidth: pushedWidth,\n'
            '                pushedHeight: pushedHeight,\n'
            '                stride: stride,\n'
            '                hostReason: hostReason,\n'
            '                intrinsicsSource: observedSource,\n'
            '                intrinsicsTraceOk: observedIkOk,\n'
            '                intrinsicsTrace: observedIk,\n'
            '                solveWallMs: Double(wall1 &- wall0) / 1_000_000.0,\n'
            '                solveCpuMs: Double(cpu1 &- cpu0) / 1_000_000.0,\n'
            '                queueWaitMs: startedAtNs > enqueuedAtNs\n'
            '                    ? Double(startedAtNs - enqueuedAtNs) / 1_000_000.0 : 0))\n'
            '        }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    // MARK: 读出\n'
            '\n'
            '    /// 写 4 个 double:最近相机 PTS、最近 IMU 时间戳、两者之差、|差| 的最大值。\n'
            '    /// 返回 0 = 有样本;-1 = 还没有。见 [lastDelta] 上面那段说明。\n'
            '    func timing(into out: UnsafeMutablePointer<Double>) -> Int32 {\n'
            '        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }\n'
            '        out[0] = lastCameraPts\n'
            '        out[1] = lastImuTs\n'
            '        out[2] = lastDelta\n'
            '        out[3] = maxAbsDelta\n'
            '        return haveDelta ? 0 : -1\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    /// [pw 2026-09-22] 写 12 个 double —— 相机时间戳换算的运行期自证(文件头偏离 (d)):\n'
            '    ///   0 c 传入值(秒)          1 c 实际施加值(C 账本 applied_offset)\n'
            '    ///   2 帧数                   3 其中曝光>0 的帧数\n'
