            '      let bits = load()\n'
            '      guard bits & Self.activeMask == 0,\n'
            '            (bits >> Self.phaseShift) & 0x3 == Phase.rejecting.rawValue else {\n'
            '        return\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      let generation = Int(UInt32(truncatingIfNeeded: bits >> 32))\n'
            '      var completion: (() -> Void)?\n'
            '      guard sealLock.try() else { return }\n'
            '      if sealGeneration == generation,\n'
            '         sealCompletion != nil,\n'
            '         seal(generation: generation) {\n'
            '        completion = sealCompletion\n'
            '        sealCompletion = nil\n'
            '        sealGeneration = nil\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      sealLock.unlock()\n'
            '      completion?()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private let admissionGate = AdmissionGate()\n'
            '  private let imageLockContention = GenerationCounter()\n'
            '  private let accelerationLockContention = GenerationCounter()\n'
            '  private let gyroscopeLockContention = GenerationCounter()\n'
            '  private let imageStopRejections = GenerationCounter()\n'
            '  private let accelerationStopRejections = GenerationCounter()\n'
            '  private let gyroscopeStopRejections = GenerationCounter()\n'
            '  private let outOfSessionImageOffers = AtomicCounter()\n'
            '  private let outOfSessionAccelerationOffers = AtomicCounter()\n'
            '  private let outOfSessionGyroscopeOffers = AtomicCounter()\n'
            '  private var sealedImageLockContention: Int?\n'
            '  private var sealedAccelerationLockContention: Int?\n'
            '  private var sealedGyroscopeLockContention: Int?\n'
            '  private var sealedImageStopRejections: Int?\n'
            '  private var sealedAccelerationStopRejections: Int?\n'
            '  private var sealedGyroscopeStopRejections: Int?\n'
            '\n'
            '  private enum SensorRejectionReason: String, CaseIterable {\n'
            '    case notRunning = "not_running"\n'
            '    case lockContention = "lock_contention"\n'
            '    case queueFull = "queue_full"\n'
            '    case cameraFull = "camera_full"\n'
            '    case lateAfterSeal = "late_after_seal"\n'
            '    case droppedOnStop = "dropped_on_stop"\n'
            '    case staleEpoch = "stale_epoch"\n'
            '    case invalidInput = "invalid_input"\n'
            '    case nonMonotonic = "non_monotonic"\n'
            '    case nativeReject = "native_reject"\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private struct SensorFacts {\n'
            '    var attempted = 0\n'
            '    var submitted = 0\n'
            '    var rejected = 0\n'
            '    var reasons = Dictionary(\n'
            '      uniqueKeysWithValues: SensorRejectionReason.allCases.map { ($0, 0) }\n'
            '    )\n'
            '\n'
            '    mutating func offer() { attempted += 1 }\n'
            '    mutating func submit() { submitted += 1 }\n'
            '    mutating func reject(_ reason: SensorRejectionReason) {\n'
            '      rejected += 1\n'
            '      reasons[reason, default: 0] += 1\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    func wire(lockContention: Int, stopRejections: Int) ->\n'
            '      (attempted: Int, submitted: Int, rejected: Int, reasons: [String: Int]) {\n'
            '      var wireReasons = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: reasons.map {\n'
            '        ($0.key.rawValue, $0.value)\n'
            '      })\n'
            '      wireReasons[SensorRejectionReason.lockContention.rawValue, default: 0] +=\n'
            '        lockContention\n'
            '      wireReasons[SensorRejectionReason.lateAfterSeal.rawValue, default: 0] +=\n'
            '        stopRejections\n'
            '      return (\n'
            '        attempted + lockContention + stopRejections,\n'
            '        submitted,\n'
            '        rejected + lockContention + stopRejections,\n'
            '        wireReasons\n'
            '      )\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private var imageFacts = SensorFacts()\n'
            '  private var accFacts = SensorFacts()\n'
            '  private var gyroFacts = SensorFacts()\n'
            '  private var overflowBase = 0\n'
            '\n'
            '  private enum ProcessingOutcome {\n'
            '    case success, invalidInput, nonMonotonic, nativeReject\n'
            '  }\n'
            '  private var terminalStale = 0\n'
            '  private var terminalInvalidInput = 0\n'
            '  private var terminalNonMonotonic = 0\n'
            '  private var terminalNativeReject = 0\n'
            '  private var terminalInternal = 0\n'
            '\n'
            '  // ── 降采样到 VIO 的工作分辨率 ──\n'
            '  // Dart selects the factor as part of the effective cross-platform config.\n'
            '  // Dart also selects the versioned kernel + rounding formula. Swift only\n'
            '  // applies that exact contract beside the source buffer and rejects unknown\n'
            '  // formulas or dimensions that cannot represent it.\n'
            '  private static let downsampleFormulaBoxNxnHalfUpV1 =\n'
            '    "box-nxn-half-up-v1"\n'
            '  private var scratch: UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>?\n'
            '  private var scratchCapacity = 0\n'
            '  private var vioWidth = 0, vioHeight = 0\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// N×N 盒式降采样。返回 nil 表示尺寸不是 N 的整数倍(不猜,直接拒绝)。\n'
            '  private func downsampleBox(src: UnsafePointer<UInt8>, srcW: Int, srcH: Int,\n'
            '                             srcStride: Int, downsampleFactor: Int,\n'
            '                             downsampleFormula: String) ->\n'
            '    (UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>, Int, Int)? {\n'
            '    guard downsampleFormula == Self.downsampleFormulaBoxNxnHalfUpV1 else {\n'
            '      return nil\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let n = downsampleFactor\n'
            '    guard n >= 1, n <= srcW, n <= srcH,\n'
            '          srcW % n == 0, srcH % n == 0 else { return nil }\n'
            '    let dw = srcW / n, dh = srcH / n\n'
            '    let need = dw * dh\n'
            '    if scratchCapacity < need {\n'
            '      scratch?.deallocate()\n'
            '      scratch = UnsafeMutablePointer<UInt8>.allocate(capacity: need)\n'
            '      scratchCapacity = need\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    guard let dst = scratch else { return nil }\n'
            '    let area = n * n\n'
            '    let half = area / 2          // 四舍五入的偏置\n'
            '    for y in 0..<dh {\n'
            '      let orow = dst + y * dw\n'
            '      for x in 0..<dw {\n'
            '        var sum = 0\n'
            '        for dy in 0..<n {\n'
            '          let row = src + (y * n + dy) * srcStride + x * n\n'
            '          for dx in 0..<n { sum += Int(row[dx]) }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        orow[x] = UInt8((sum + half) / area)\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    vioWidth = dw; vioHeight = dh\n'
            '    return (dst, dw, dh)\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// XRSLAM 是全局单例(C API 没有句柄参数),全部入口只允许 coreQueue 调用。\n'
            '  private var lastImageT: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var lastImuT: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var accSumX: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var accSumY: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var accSumZ: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var accNativeSubmittedCount = 0\n'
            '  private var runCalls = 0\n'
            '  private var lastImageRc: Int32 = 0\n'
            '  private var lastAccRc: Int32 = 0\n'
            '  private var lastGyroRc: Int32 = 0\n'
            '  private var lastHealthRc: Int32 = 2\n'
            '  private var cachedHealth: [String: Any] = [:]\n'
            '  private var cachedSnapshot: [String: Any] = [:]\n'
            '\n'
            '  private var feedWallStartedAtUptimeSeconds: CFTimeInterval = 0\n'
            '  private var solveWallSum: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var previousImageTimestamp: Double = 0\n'
            '  private var workerFrameCount = 0\n'
            '  private var workerFrameMsSum = 0.0\n'
            '  private var enqueueLatencyUsSum = 0.0\n'
            '\n'
            '  private var sessionStartedAt: CFTimeInterval = 0\n'
            '\n'
            '  // Transient raw status observations. Each processed image offers one. Dart\n'
            '  // consumes and clears them, then persists aggregate classifications only.\n'
            '  private var poseObservationSequence = 0\n'
            '  private var poseObservationsOffered = 0\n'
            '  private var poseObservationsDropped = 0\n'
            '  private var poseObservations: [[String: Any]] = []\n'
            '\n'
            '  private var lastStartRequest: StartRequest?\n'
            '  // Only the ARSession delegate callback reads/writes these two values. The\n'
            '  // generation stamp makes the first frame of every native run pass without\n'
            '  // a cross-thread reset. Dart selects the rate; Swift only applies it.\n'
            '  private var lastAdmittedCameraTimestamp = -Double.infinity\n'
            '  private var lastAdmittedCameraGeneration: UInt32 = 0\n'
            '  private var cameraRateSampledOut = 0\n'
            '\n'
            '  // MARK: - 生命周期\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func transitionLocked(to next: ShadowState) {\n'
            '    let previous = state\n'
            '    state = next\n'
            '    if stateTransitions.count == Self.maxStateTransitions {\n'
            '      stateTransitions.removeFirst()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    stateTransitions.append("\\(previous.rawValue)->\\(next.rawValue)")\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func resetSessionMetricsLocked(generation: Int) {\n'
            '    pendingWork = Array<PendingWork?>(\n'
            '      repeating: nil,\n'
            '      count: Self.maxQueuedWork\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    pendingHead = 0\n'
            '    pendingTail = 0\n'
            '    pendingCount = 0\n'
            '    pendingImageCount = 0\n'
            '    inFlightImageCount = 0\n'
            '    maxRetainedImageCount = 0\n'
            '    drainScheduled = false\n'
            '    inFlightCount = 0\n'
            '    queueAccepted = 0\n'
            '    queueProcessedSuccess = 0\n'
            '    droppedOnStop = 0\n'
            '    terminalRejected = 0\n'
            '    terminalStale = 0\n'
            '    terminalInvalidInput = 0\n'
            '    terminalNonMonotonic = 0\n'
            '    terminalNativeReject = 0\n'
            '    terminalInternal = 0\n'
            '    maxQueueBacklog = 0\n'
            '    shadowRunInvalidated = false\n'
            '    runInvalidationReasons.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    stateTransitions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    shutdownDrops = 0\n'
            '    nativeDestroyReceipt.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    imageFacts = SensorFacts()\n'
            '    accFacts = SensorFacts()\n'
            '    gyroFacts = SensorFacts()\n'
            '    overflowBase = 0\n'
            '    sealedImageLockContention = nil\n'
            '    sealedAccelerationLockContention = nil\n'
            '    sealedGyroscopeLockContention = nil\n'
            '    sealedImageStopRejections = nil\n'
            '    sealedAccelerationStopRejections = nil\n'
            '    sealedGyroscopeStopRejections = nil\n'
            '    imageLockContention.beginGeneration(generation)\n'
            '    accelerationLockContention.beginGeneration(generation)\n'
            '    gyroscopeLockContention.beginGeneration(generation)\n'
            '    imageStopRejections.beginGeneration(generation)\n'
            '    accelerationStopRejections.beginGeneration(generation)\n'
            '    gyroscopeStopRejections.beginGeneration(generation)\n'
            '    lastImageT = 0\n'
            '    lastImuT = 0\n'
            '    accSumX = 0\n'
            '    accSumY = 0\n'
            '    accSumZ = 0\n'
            '    accNativeSubmittedCount = 0\n'
            '    runCalls = 0\n'
            '    lastImageRc = 0\n'
            '    lastAccRc = 0\n'
            '    lastGyroRc = 0\n'
            '    lastHealthRc = 2\n'
            '    cachedHealth.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    feedWallStartedAtUptimeSeconds = 0\n'
            '    solveWallSum = 0\n'
            '    previousImageTimestamp = 0\n'
            '    workerFrameCount = 0\n'
            '    workerFrameMsSum = 0\n'
            '    enqueueLatencyUsSum = 0\n'
            '    sessionStartedAt = CACurrentMediaTime()\n'
            '    poseObservationSequence = 0\n'
            '    poseObservationsOffered = 0\n'
            '    poseObservationsDropped = 0\n'
            '    cameraRateSampledOut = 0\n'
            '    poseObservations.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func beginStartLocked(\n'
            '    _ request: StartRequest,\n'
            '    completions: [(Int32, Int) -> Void]\n'
            '  ) -> Int? {\n'
            '    sessionGeneration += 1\n'
            '    let epoch = sessionGeneration\n'
            '    resetSessionMetricsLocked(generation: epoch)\n'
            '    // Publish only after every generation-scoped counter has reset. `begin`\n'
            '    // refuses to overwrite any live lease from the prior generation.\n'
            '    guard admissionGate.begin(generation: epoch) else { return nil }\n'
            '    lastStartRequest = request\n'
            '    startCompletions.append(contentsOf: completions)\n'
            '    transitionLocked(to: .starting)\n'
            '    cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '    return epoch\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Core-create failure uses the same sealed terminal path as an explicit\n'
            '  /// stop. Caller holds `lock`; completion is withheld until every callback\n'
            '  /// lease from `epoch` has left and AdmissionGate.seal succeeds.\n'
            '  private func closeFailedCreateGeneration(epoch: Int) -> Bool {\n'
            '    guard sessionGeneration == epoch, state == .starting else { return false }\n'
            '    created = false\n'
            '    transitionLocked(to: .stopping)\n'
            '    admissionGate.beginRejecting(generation: epoch)\n'
            '    rejectPendingOnStopLocked()\n'
            '    cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '    return true\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func scheduleCreate(_ request: StartRequest, epoch: Int) {\n'
            '    coreQueue.async { [weak self] in\n'
            '      guard let self else { return }\n'
            '      let rc = request.slamConfigPath.withCString { slam in\n'
            '        request.deviceConfigPath.withCString { device in\n'
            '          PWXrslamTransportCreateWithCameraTimeOffset(\n'
            '            slam,\n'
            '            device,\n'
            '            request.cameraTimeOffsetSeconds\n'
            '          )\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '\n'
            '      var completed: [(Int32, Int) -> Void] = []\n'
            '      var destroyOrphan = false\n'
            '      var shouldCloseFailedCreate = false\n'
            '      self.lock.lock()\n'
            '      if self.sessionGeneration == epoch {\n'
            '        self.created = (rc == 1)\n'
            '        if self.state == .starting, self.created {\n'
            '          self.transitionLocked(to: .running)\n'
            '          completed = self.startCompletions\n'
            '          self.startCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '        } else if self.state == .starting {\n'
            '          shouldCloseFailedCreate = self.closeFailedCreateGeneration(\n'
            '            epoch: epoch\n'
            '          )\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        // If stop raced Create, state is stopping. The start completions stay\n'
            '        // pending until Destroy has completed, then finish with rc=0. A stale\n'
            '        // success can therefore never restart CoreMotion after stop.\n'
            '        self.cachedSnapshot = self.makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '      } else if rc == 1 {\n'
            '        // A newer generation cannot inherit a process-global core instance\n'
            '        // created for an obsolete request. This block still owns coreQueue, so\n'
            '        // Destroy is ordered before any newer Create.\n'
            '        destroyOrphan = true\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      self.lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '      if destroyOrphan { PWXrslamTransportDestroy() }\n'
            '      if shouldCloseFailedCreate {\n'
            '        self.finishStopOnCoreQueue()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '\n'
            '      if !completed.isEmpty {\n'
            '        DispatchQueue.main.async {\n'
            '          for completion in completed { completion(1, epoch) }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Create is asynchronous and serialized with every later XRSLAM call.\n'
            '  /// A start received while stopping becomes one coalesced post-Destroy\n'
            '  /// restart rather than being lost or lying with an immediate success code.\n'
            '  public func start(\n'
            '    slamConfigPath: String,\n'
            '    deviceConfigPath: String,\n'
            '    sessionId: String,\n'
            '    sessionEpoch: Int,\n'
            '    effectiveConfigSha256: String,\n'
            '    inputIdentitySha256: String,\n'
            '    downsampleFactor: Int,\n'
            '    downsampleFormula: String,\n'
            '    requestedCameraHz: Double,\n'
            '    cameraTimeOffsetSeconds: Double,\n'
            '    accelerationScale: Double,\n'
            '    requestedAccelerometerHz: Double,\n'
            '    requestedGyroscopeHz: Double,\n'
            '    completion: @escaping (Int32, Int) -> Void\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    guard downsampleFactor > 0,\n'
            '          downsampleFormula == Self.downsampleFormulaBoxNxnHalfUpV1,\n'
            '          requestedCameraHz.isFinite,\n'
            '          requestedCameraHz > 0,\n'
            '          cameraTimeOffsetSeconds.isFinite,\n'
            '          accelerationScale.isFinite,\n'
            '          accelerationScale != 0,\n'
            '          requestedAccelerometerHz.isFinite,\n'
            '          requestedAccelerometerHz > 0,\n'
            '          requestedGyroscopeHz.isFinite,\n'
            '          requestedGyroscopeHz > 0 else {\n'
            '      DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(0, 0) }\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let request = StartRequest(\n'
            '      slamConfigPath: slamConfigPath,\n'
            '      deviceConfigPath: deviceConfigPath,\n'
            '      sessionId: sessionId,\n'
            '      sessionEpoch: sessionEpoch,\n'
            '      effectiveConfigSha256: effectiveConfigSha256,\n'
            '      inputIdentitySha256: inputIdentitySha256,\n'
            '      downsampleFactor: downsampleFactor,\n'
            '      downsampleFormula: downsampleFormula,\n'
            '      requestedCameraHz: requestedCameraHz,\n'
            '      cameraTimeOffsetSeconds: cameraTimeOffsetSeconds,\n'
            '      accelerationScale: accelerationScale,\n'
            '      requestedAccelerometerHz: requestedAccelerometerHz,\n'
            '      requestedGyroscopeHz: requestedGyroscopeHz\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    switch state {\n'
            '    case .running:\n'
            '      let active = lastStartRequest\n'
            '      let generation = sessionGeneration\n'
            '      // Idempotent start is truthful only for the configuration that is\n'
            '      // actually active. Callers requesting a different configuration must\n'
            '      // explicitly stop/restart rather than receiving a false success.\n'
            '      let success = created && active.map(request.matches) == true\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(success ? 1 : 0, generation) }\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    case .starting:\n'
            '      if lastStartRequest.map(request.matches) == true {\n'
            '        startCompletions.append(completion)\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '      } else {\n'
            '        let generation = sessionGeneration\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(0, generation) }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    case .stopping:\n'
            '      if let pendingRestart, !request.matches(pendingRestart) {\n'
            '        // Latest distinct restart wins; completions for a superseded request\n'
            '        // finish false after Destroy, never true for somebody else\'s config.\n'
            '        canceledStartCompletions.append(\n'
            '          contentsOf: pendingRestartCompletions)\n'
            '        pendingRestartCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      pendingRestart = request\n'
            '      pendingRestartCompletions.append(completion)\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    case .stopped:\n'
            '      guard let epoch = beginStartLocked(\n'
            '        request,\n'
            '        completions: [completion]\n'
            '      ) else {\n'
            '        let generation = sessionGeneration\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(0, generation) }\n'
            '        return\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      // Enqueue Create before publishing the unlocked `.starting` state. A\n'
            '      // racing stop will then enqueue Destroy/drain *after* Create, never\n'
            '      // before it.\n'
            '      scheduleCreate(request, epoch: epoch)\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func rejectPendingOnStopLocked() {\n'
            '    while pendingCount > 0 {\n'
            '      guard let item = pendingWork[pendingHead] else {\n'
            '        terminalInternal += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: "internal_empty_queue_slot")\n'
            '        pendingHead = (pendingHead + 1) % Self.maxQueuedWork\n'
            '        pendingCount -= 1\n'
            '        continue\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      pendingWork[pendingHead] = nil\n'
            '      pendingHead = (pendingHead + 1) % Self.maxQueuedWork\n'
            '      pendingCount -= 1\n'
            '      if item.isImage {\n'
            '        pendingImageCount -= 1\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      droppedOnStop += 1\n'
            '      shutdownDrops += 1\n'
            '      rejectSensorLocked(stream: item.stream, reason: .droppedOnStop)\n'
            '      invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.droppedOnStop.rawValue)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    pendingHead = 0\n'
            '    pendingTail = 0\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Stop closes admission immediately, accounts every pending item, and then\n'
            '  /// queues Destroy behind any in-flight native call. It never waits/syncs.\n'
            '  public func stop(\n'
            '    completion: @escaping ([String: Any]) -> Void = { _ in }\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    if state == .stopped {\n'
            '      let receipt: [String: Any] = [\n'
            '        "schema": "pw.vio.shadow-terminal-unavailable/1",\n'
            '        "sessionGeneration": sessionGeneration,\n'
            '        "receiptAvailable": false,\n'
            '      ]\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(receipt) }\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    // A later stop supersedes a resume queued during the current stop. Those\n'
            '    // start callers finish with rc=0 only after the terminal stopped state.\n'
            '    if pendingRestart != nil {\n'
            '      pendingRestart = nil\n'
            '      canceledStartCompletions.append(\n'
            '        contentsOf: pendingRestartCompletions)\n'
            '      pendingRestartCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if state == .stopping {\n'
            '      // Join the in-progress linearized stop. No caller may observe completion\n'
            '      // before in-flight C work, Destroy, and receipt freezing have finished.\n'
            '      stopCompletions.append(completion)\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    stopCompletions.append(completion)\n'
            '    transitionLocked(to: .stopping)\n'
            '    admissionGate.beginRejecting(generation: sessionGeneration)\n'
            '    rejectPendingOnStopLocked()\n'
            '    let epoch = sessionGeneration\n'
            '    let shouldSchedule = !drainScheduled\n'
            '    if shouldSchedule { drainScheduled = true }\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    if shouldSchedule {\n'
            '      coreQueue.async { [weak self] in self?.drain(epoch: epoch) }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  public var isRunning: Bool {\n'
            '    lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }\n'
            '    return state == .running && created\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Freezes the running facts only for the exact Create completion epoch.\n'
            '  /// Generic snapshots never establish start provenance in Dart.\n'
            '  public func directRunningReceipt(expectedGeneration: Int) -> [String: Any]? {\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    defer { lock.unlock() }\n'
            '    guard expectedGeneration > 0,\n'
            '          sessionGeneration == expectedGeneration,\n'
            '          state == .running,\n'
            '          created else { return nil }\n'
            '    return makeWireSnapshotLocked(includeRaw: false)\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private enum AdmissionRejection {\n'
            '    case notRunning, staleEpoch\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func offerSensorLocked(stream: SensorStream) {\n'
            '    switch stream {\n'
            '    case .image: imageFacts.offer()\n'
            '    case .acceleration: accFacts.offer()\n'
            '    case .gyroscope: gyroFacts.offer()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func rejectSensorLocked(\n'
            '    stream: SensorStream,\n'
            '    reason: SensorRejectionReason\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    switch stream {\n'
            '    case .image: imageFacts.reject(reason)\n'
            '    case .acceleration: accFacts.reject(reason)\n'
            '    case .gyroscope: gyroFacts.reject(reason)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func noteOutOfSessionOffer(stream: SensorStream) {\n'
            '    switch stream {\n'
            '    case .image: outOfSessionImageOffers.increment()\n'
            '    case .acceleration: outOfSessionAccelerationOffers.increment()\n'
            '    case .gyroscope: outOfSessionGyroscopeOffers.increment()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func noteLockContention(\n'
            '    stream: SensorStream,\n'
            '    generation: UInt32\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    switch stream {\n'
            '    case .image:\n'
            '      if !imageLockContention.increment(generation: generation) {\n'
            '        outOfSessionImageOffers.increment()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    case .acceleration:\n'
            '      if !accelerationLockContention.increment(generation: generation) {\n'
            '        outOfSessionAccelerationOffers.increment()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    case .gyroscope:\n'
            '      if !gyroscopeLockContention.increment(generation: generation) {\n'
            '        outOfSessionGyroscopeOffers.increment()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func invalidateRunLocked(reason: String) {\n'
            '    shadowRunInvalidated = true\n'
            '    runInvalidationReasons[reason, default: 0] += 1\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func rejectUnadmittedLocked(\n'
            '    stream: SensorStream,\n'
            '    reason: AdmissionRejection\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    let sensorReason: SensorRejectionReason\n'
            '    switch reason {\n'
            '    case .notRunning:\n'
            '      sensorReason = .notRunning\n'
            '    case .staleEpoch:\n'
            '      sensorReason = .staleEpoch\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    rejectSensorLocked(stream: stream, reason: sensorReason)\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Nonblocking bounded admission. A callback that cannot acquire the short\n'
            '  /// ledger lock or fit inside either hard capacity returns immediately and\n'
            '  /// invalidates the shadow run; it never paces production capture.\n'
            '  private func admit(\n'
            '    _ unscopedWork: PendingWork,\n'
            '    lease: AdmissionGate.Entry\n'
            '  ) -> Bool {\n'
            '    guard lock.try() else {\n'
            '      noteLockContention(\n'
            '        stream: unscopedWork.stream,\n'
            '        generation: lease.generation\n'
            '      )\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    offerSensorLocked(stream: unscopedWork.stream)\n'
            '    guard state == .running && created else {\n'
            '      rejectUnadmittedLocked(\n'
            '        stream: unscopedWork.stream,\n'
            '        reason: .notRunning\n'
            '      )\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let generation = UInt32(truncatingIfNeeded: sessionGeneration)\n'
            '    guard lease.generation == generation else {\n'
            '      rejectUnadmittedLocked(\n'
            '        stream: unscopedWork.stream,\n'
            '        reason: .staleEpoch\n'
            '      )\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let epoch = sessionGeneration\n'
            '    let work: PendingWork\n'
            '    switch unscopedWork {\n'
            '    case .image(let frame, _): work = .image(frame, epoch: epoch)\n'
            '    case .acceleration(let sample, _):\n'
            '      work = .acceleration(sample, epoch: epoch)\n'
            '    case .gyroscope(let sample, _):\n'
            '      work = .gyroscope(sample, epoch: epoch)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    guard pendingCount < Self.maxQueuedWork else {\n'
            '      rejectSensorLocked(stream: work.stream, reason: .queueFull)\n'
            '      overflowBase += 1\n'
            '      invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.queueFull.rawValue)\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if work.isImage {\n'
            '      guard pendingImageCount + inFlightImageCount < Self.maxRetainedImages\n'
            '      else {\n'
            '        rejectSensorLocked(stream: work.stream, reason: .cameraFull)\n'
            '        overflowBase += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.cameraFull.rawValue)\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        return false\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    pendingWork[pendingTail] = work\n'
            '    pendingTail = (pendingTail + 1) % Self.maxQueuedWork\n'
            '    pendingCount += 1\n'
            '    if work.isImage {\n'
            '      pendingImageCount += 1\n'
            '      maxRetainedImageCount = max(\n'
            '        maxRetainedImageCount,\n'
            '        pendingImageCount + inFlightImageCount\n'
            '      )\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    queueAccepted += 1\n'
            '    maxQueueBacklog = max(maxQueueBacklog, pendingCount)\n'
            '    let shouldSchedule = !drainScheduled\n'
            '    if shouldSchedule { drainScheduled = true }\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '    if shouldSchedule {\n'
            '      coreQueue.async { [weak self] in self?.drain(epoch: epoch) }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return true\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  // MARK: - 喂帧\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// ARKit hot path: retain at most one bounded pixel-buffer reference and\n'
            '  /// return. No downsample, native call, wait, or synchronous dispatch occurs.\n'
            '  @discardableResult\n'
            '  public func enqueue(frame: ARFrame) -> Bool {\n'
            '    guard let lease = admissionGate.enter() else {\n'
            '      outOfSessionImageOffers.increment()\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    defer { admissionGate.leave(lease) }\n'
            '    guard lease.phase == .open else {\n'
            '      if !imageStopRejections.increment(generation: lease.generation) {\n'
            '        outOfSessionImageOffers.increment()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let requestedCameraHz = lastStartRequest?.requestedCameraHz ?? 0\n'
            '    guard requestedCameraHz.isFinite, requestedCameraHz > 0 else {\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let cameraPeriod = 1.0 / requestedCameraHz\n'
            '    if lastAdmittedCameraGeneration == lease.generation,\n'
            '       frame.timestamp - lastAdmittedCameraTimestamp < cameraPeriod {\n'
            '      cameraRateSampledOut += 1\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    lastAdmittedCameraGeneration = lease.generation\n'
            '    lastAdmittedCameraTimestamp = frame.timestamp\n'
            '    let tracking: (state: String, reason: String)\n'
            '    switch frame.camera.trackingState {\n'
            '    case .normal:\n'
            '      tracking = ("normal", "none")\n'
            '    case .notAvailable:\n'
            '      tracking = ("notAvailable", "none")\n'
            '    case .limited(let reason):\n'
            '      let rawReason: String\n'
            '      switch reason {\n'
            '      case .initializing: rawReason = "initializing"\n'
            '      case .excessiveMotion: rawReason = "excessiveMotion"\n'
            '      case .insufficientFeatures: rawReason = "insufficientFeatures"\n'
            '      case .relocalizing: rawReason = "relocalizing"\n'
            '      @unknown default: rawReason = "unknown"\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      tracking = ("limited", rawReason)\n'
            '    @unknown default:\n'
            '      tracking = ("unknown", "unknown")\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let pending = PendingFrame(\n'
            '      pixelBuffer: frame.capturedImage,\n'
            '      timestamp: frame.timestamp,\n'
            '      arkitWorldFromCamera: frame.camera.transform,\n'
            '      referenceTrackingState: tracking.state,\n'
            '      referenceTrackingReason: tracking.reason,\n'
            '      enqueuedAt: CACurrentMediaTime()\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    return admit(.image(pending, epoch: 0), lease: lease)\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func processFrameOnCore(\n'
            '    _ pending: PendingFrame,\n'
            '    generation: UInt32,\n'
            '    downsampleFactor: Int,\n'
            '    downsampleFormula: String\n'
            '  ) -> ProcessingOutcome {\n'
            '    let workerStartedAt = CACurrentMediaTime()\n'
            '    defer {\n'
            '      let workerMs = (CACurrentMediaTime() - workerStartedAt) * 1000.0\n'
            '      lock.lock()\n'
            '      workerFrameCount += 1\n'
            '      workerFrameMsSum += workerMs\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let enqueueLatencyUs = (workerStartedAt - pending.enqueuedAt) * 1_000_000.0\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    enqueueLatencyUsSum += enqueueLatencyUs\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '    guard pending.timestamp.isFinite else {\n'
            '      lock.lock(); imageFacts.reject(.invalidInput); lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let pb = pending.pixelBuffer\n'
            '    guard CVPixelBufferGetPlaneCount(pb) >= 1 else {\n'
            '      lock.lock(); imageFacts.reject(.invalidInput); lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    let pixelLockStatus = CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(pb, .readOnly)\n'
            '    guard pixelLockStatus == kCVReturnSuccess else {\n'
            '      lock.lock(); imageFacts.reject(.invalidInput); lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    defer { CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(pb, .readOnly) }\n'
            '    guard let base = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(pb, 0) else {\n'
            '      lock.lock(); imageFacts.reject(.invalidInput); lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    let w = CVPixelBufferGetWidthOfPlane(pb, 0)\n'
            '    let h = CVPixelBufferGetHeightOfPlane(pb, 0)\n'
            '    let stride = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(pb, 0)\n'
            '\n'
            '    // 降采样。失败(尺寸不是倍数的整数倍)就**拒绝这一帧并计数**,\n'
            '    // 不退回全分辨率 —— 那正是撑崩 App 的那条路。\n'
            '    let srcPtr = base.assumingMemoryBound(to: UInt8.self)\n'
            '    guard let (small, sw, _) =\n'
            '            downsampleBox(\n'
            '              src: srcPtr,\n'
            '              srcW: w,\n'
            '              srcH: h,\n'
            '              srcStride: stride,\n'
            '              downsampleFactor: downsampleFactor,\n'
            '              downsampleFormula: downsampleFormula\n'
            '            ) else {\n'
            '      lock.lock(); imageFacts.reject(.invalidInput); lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    var rawState: Int32 = 0\n'
            '    var rawPose = PWXrslamRawPose()\n'
            '    let t0 = CACurrentMediaTime()\n'
            '    let rc = PWXrslamTransportPushCameraAndRunRaw(\n'
            '      small,\n'
            '      pending.timestamp,\n'
            '      Int32(sw),\n'
            '      0,\n'
            '      1,\n'
            '      &rawState,\n'
            '      &rawPose\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let span = (CACurrentMediaTime() - t0) * 1000.0\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    lastImageRc = rc\n'
            '    if rc == 0 {\n'
            '      imageFacts.submit()\n'
            '      previousImageTimestamp = lastImageT\n'
            '      lastImageT = pending.timestamp\n'
            '    } else if rc == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_ERR_NON_MONOTONIC.rawValue) {\n'
            '      imageFacts.reject(.nonMonotonic)\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      imageFacts.reject(.nativeReject)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    if rc == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_ERR_NON_MONOTONIC.rawValue) {\n'
            '      return .nonMonotonic\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    guard rc == 0 else { return .nativeReject }\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    runCalls += 1\n'
            '    solveWallSum += span / 1000.0\n'
            '    if feedWallStartedAtUptimeSeconds == 0 {\n'
            '      feedWallStartedAtUptimeSeconds = t0\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    updateHealthOnCore(frameMs: span, rawState: rawState)\n'
            '    observePoseAndPrepareWire(\n'
            '      frame: pending,\n'
            '      generation: generation,\n'
            '      rawState: rawState,\n'
            '      rawPose: rawPose\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    return .success\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// 运输一个原始加速度计样本。此处只拷贝 G 单位原值;\n'
            '  /// Dart 选择的单位/符号换算在 serial coreQueue 上执行。\n'
            '  @discardableResult\n'
            '  public func enqueue(acceleration sample: CMAccelerometerData) -> Bool {\n'
            '    guard let lease = admissionGate.enter() else {\n'
            '      outOfSessionAccelerationOffers.increment()\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    defer { admissionGate.leave(lease) }\n'
            '    guard lease.phase == .open else {\n'
            '      if !accelerationStopRejections.increment(generation: lease.generation) {\n'
            '        outOfSessionAccelerationOffers.increment()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let pending = PendingAcceleration(\n'
            '      timestamp: sample.timestamp,\n'
            '      x: sample.acceleration.x,\n'
            '      y: sample.acceleration.y,\n'
            '      z: sample.acceleration.z\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    return admit(.acceleration(pending, epoch: 0), lease: lease)\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// 运输一个原始陀螺仪样本,rad/s 原值不改。\n'
            '  @discardableResult\n'
            '  public func enqueue(gyroscope sample: CMGyroData) -> Bool {\n'
            '    guard let lease = admissionGate.enter() else {\n'
            '      outOfSessionGyroscopeOffers.increment()\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    defer { admissionGate.leave(lease) }\n'
            '    guard lease.phase == .open else {\n'
            '      if !gyroscopeStopRejections.increment(generation: lease.generation) {\n'
            '        outOfSessionGyroscopeOffers.increment()\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return false\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let pending = PendingGyroscope(\n'
            '      timestamp: sample.timestamp,\n'
            '      x: sample.rotationRate.x,\n'
            '      y: sample.rotationRate.y,\n'
            '      z: sample.rotationRate.z\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    return admit(.gyroscope(pending, epoch: 0), lease: lease)\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func processAccelerationOnCore(\n'
            '    _ pending: PendingAcceleration,\n'
            '    accelerationScale: Double\n'
            '  ) -> ProcessingOutcome {\n'
            '    guard pending.timestamp.isFinite,\n'
            '          pending.x.isFinite, pending.y.isFinite, pending.z.isFinite,\n'
            '          accelerationScale.isFinite, accelerationScale != 0 else {\n'
            '      lock.lock()\n'
            '      accFacts.reject(.invalidInput)\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let scaledX = pending.x * accelerationScale\n'
            '    let scaledY = pending.y * accelerationScale\n'
            '    let scaledZ = pending.z * accelerationScale\n'
            '    let accRc = PWXrslamTransportPushAccelerationRaw(\n'
            '      pending.timestamp,\n'
            '      scaledX,\n'
            '      scaledY,\n'
            '      scaledZ\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    lastAccRc = accRc\n'
            '    if accRc == 0 {\n'
            '      accFacts.submit()\n'
            '      accNativeSubmittedCount += 1\n'
            '      lastImuT = pending.timestamp\n'
            '    } else if accRc == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_ERR_NON_MONOTONIC.rawValue) {\n'
            '      accFacts.reject(.nonMonotonic)\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      accFacts.reject(.nativeReject)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    accSumX += scaledX\n'
            '    accSumY += scaledY\n'
            '    accSumZ += scaledZ\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    if accRc == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_ERR_NON_MONOTONIC.rawValue) {\n'
            '      return .nonMonotonic\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return accRc == 0 ? .success : .nativeReject\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func processGyroscopeOnCore(\n'
            '    _ pending: PendingGyroscope\n'
            '  ) -> ProcessingOutcome {\n'
            '    guard pending.timestamp.isFinite,\n'
            '          pending.x.isFinite, pending.y.isFinite, pending.z.isFinite else {\n'
            '      lock.lock()\n'
            '      gyroFacts.reject(.invalidInput)\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return .invalidInput\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let gyroRc = PWXrslamTransportPushGyroscopeRaw(\n'
            '      pending.timestamp,\n'
            '      pending.x,\n'
            '      pending.y,\n'
            '      pending.z\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    lastGyroRc = gyroRc\n'
            '    if gyroRc == 0 {\n'
            '      gyroFacts.submit()\n'
            '      lastImuT = pending.timestamp\n'
            '    } else if gyroRc == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_ERR_NON_MONOTONIC.rawValue) {\n'
            '      gyroFacts.reject(.nonMonotonic)\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      gyroFacts.reject(.nativeReject)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    if gyroRc == Int32(PW_XRSLAM_ERR_NON_MONOTONIC.rawValue) {\n'
            '      return .nonMonotonic\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return gyroRc == 0 ? .success : .nativeReject\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// The only closure submitted for data work. At most one drain is scheduled;\n'
            '  /// admission never schedules one closure per sensor sample.\n'
            '  private func drain(epoch: Int) {\n'
            '    while true {\n'
            '      lock.lock()\n'
            '      if pendingCount == 0 {\n'
            '        pendingHead = 0\n'
            '        pendingTail = 0\n'
            '        if state == .stopping {\n'
            '          lock.unlock()\n'
            '          finishStopOnCoreQueue()\n'
            '          return\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        drainScheduled = false\n'
            '        cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        return\n'
            '      }\n'
            '\n'
            '      guard var item = pendingWork[pendingHead] else {\n'
            '        pendingHead = (pendingHead + 1) % Self.maxQueuedWork\n'
            '        pendingCount -= 1\n'
            '        terminalRejected += 1\n'
            '        terminalInternal += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: "internal_empty_queue_slot")\n'
            '        cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        continue\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      pendingWork[pendingHead] = nil\n'
            '      pendingHead = (pendingHead + 1) % Self.maxQueuedWork\n'
            '      pendingCount -= 1\n'
            '      if item.isImage { pendingImageCount -= 1 }\n'
            '\n'
            '      // Count the locally retained item before releasing the lock.\n'
            '      inFlightCount = 1\n'
            '      inFlightImageCount = item.isImage ? 1 : 0\n'
            '\n'
            '      let selectedStartRequest = lastStartRequest\n'
            '      let current = item.epoch == epoch &&\n'
            '        item.epoch == sessionGeneration && state == .running && created &&\n'
            '        selectedStartRequest != nil\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '      guard current,\n'
            '            let selectedStartRequest = selectedStartRequest else {\n'
            '        let staleStream = item.stream\n'
            '        // Release any CVPixelBuffer before publishing inFlightImageCount=0.\n'
            '        // The logical ceiling and the actual ARC strong-reference ceiling are\n'
            '        // therefore the same hard bound.\n'
            '        item = .gyroscope(\n'
            '          PendingGyroscope(timestamp: 0, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0),\n'
            '          epoch: item.epoch\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        lock.lock()\n'
            '        rejectSensorLocked(stream: staleStream, reason: .staleEpoch)\n'
            '        terminalRejected += 1\n'
            '        terminalStale += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.staleEpoch.rawValue)\n'
            '        inFlightCount = 0\n'
            '        inFlightImageCount = 0\n'
            '        cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '        lock.unlock()\n'
            '        continue\n'
            '      }\n'
            '\n'
            '      let outcome: ProcessingOutcome\n'
            '      switch item {\n'
            '      case .image(let frame, _):\n'
            '        outcome = processFrameOnCore(\n'
            '          frame,\n'
            '          generation: UInt32(truncatingIfNeeded: item.epoch),\n'
            '          downsampleFactor: selectedStartRequest.downsampleFactor,\n'
            '          downsampleFormula: selectedStartRequest.downsampleFormula\n'
            '        )\n'
            '      case .acceleration(let sample, _):\n'
            '        outcome = processAccelerationOnCore(\n'
            '          sample,\n'
            '          accelerationScale: selectedStartRequest.accelerationScale\n'
            '        )\n'
            '      case .gyroscope(let sample, _):\n'
            '        outcome = processGyroscopeOnCore(sample)\n'
            '      }\n'
            '\n'
            '      // Drop the local PendingFrame (and its CVPixelBuffer) before admission\n'
            '      // can observe an empty in-flight slot.\n'
            '      item = .gyroscope(\n'
            '        PendingGyroscope(timestamp: 0, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0),\n'
            '        epoch: item.epoch\n'
            '      )\n'
            '\n'
            '      lock.lock()\n'
            '      inFlightCount = 0\n'
            '      inFlightImageCount = 0\n'
            '      switch outcome {\n'
            '      case .success:\n'
            '        queueProcessedSuccess += 1\n'
            '      case .invalidInput:\n'
            '        terminalRejected += 1\n'
            '        terminalInvalidInput += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.invalidInput.rawValue)\n'
            '      case .nonMonotonic:\n'
            '        terminalRejected += 1\n'
            '        terminalNonMonotonic += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.nonMonotonic.rawValue)\n'
            '      case .nativeReject:\n'
            '        terminalRejected += 1\n'
            '        terminalNativeReject += 1\n'
            '        invalidateRunLocked(reason: SensorRejectionReason.nativeReject.rawValue)\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      // Work conservation is deliberately spelled out in native source and\n'
            '      // independently recomputed by Dart from the wire snapshot.\n'
            '      assert(\n'
            '        queueAccepted == queueProcessedSuccess + droppedOnStop +\n'
            '          terminalRejected + pendingCount + inFlightCount\n'
            '      )\n'
            '      cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func finishStopOnCoreQueue() {\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    let generation = sessionGeneration\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    admissionGate.sealWhenQuiescent(generation: generation) { [weak self] in\n'
            '      guard let self else { return }\n'
            '      self.coreQueue.async { [weak self] in\n'
            '        self?.finishSealedStopOnCoreQueue(generation: generation)\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func finishSealedStopOnCoreQueue(generation: Int) {\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    guard sessionGeneration == generation, state == .stopping else {\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    let shouldDestroy = created\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    var destroyReceipt = PWXrslamDestroyReceipt()\n'
            '    let destroyRc: Int32\n'
            '    if shouldDestroy {\n'
            '      destroyRc = PWXrslamTransportDestroyWithReceipt(&destroyReceipt)\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      destroyRc = -2\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    var canceledStarts: [(Int32, Int) -> Void] = []\n'
            '    var completedStops: [([String: Any]) -> Void] = []\n'
            '    var restartRequest: StartRequest?\n'
            '    var restartEpoch: Int?\n'
            '    var terminalReceipt: [String: Any] = [:]\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    nativeDestroyReceipt = [\n'
            '      "nativeDestroyRc": Int(destroyRc),\n'
            '      "nativeDestroyAcknowledged": Int(\n'
            '        destroyReceipt.destroy_acknowledged\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      "nativeLifecycleGeneration": destroyReceipt.lifecycle_generation,\n'
            '      "nativeCameraSubmitted": destroyReceipt.camera_submitted,\n'
            '      "nativeCameraRunCalls": destroyReceipt.camera_run_calls,\n'
            '      "nativeAccelerationSubmitted": destroyReceipt.acceleration_submitted,\n'
            '      "nativeGyroscopeSubmitted": destroyReceipt.gyroscope_submitted,\n'
            '      "nativeRejectedInvalidArgument":\n'
            '        destroyReceipt.rejected_invalid_argument,\n'
            '      "nativeRejectedNonMonotonic":\n'
            '        destroyReceipt.rejected_non_monotonic,\n'
            '      "nativeRejectedNotRunning": destroyReceipt.rejected_not_running,\n'
            '    ]\n'
            '    if shouldDestroy &&\n'
            '       (destroyRc != 0 || destroyReceipt.destroy_acknowledged != 1) {\n'
            '      invalidateRunLocked(reason: "native_destroy_unacknowledged")\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    sealedImageLockContention = imageLockContention.seal(\n'
            '      generation: generation\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    sealedAccelerationLockContention = accelerationLockContention.seal(\n'
            '      generation: generation\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    sealedGyroscopeLockContention = gyroscopeLockContention.seal(\n'
            '      generation: generation\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    sealedImageStopRejections = imageStopRejections.seal(\n'
            '      generation: generation\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    sealedAccelerationStopRejections = accelerationStopRejections.seal(\n'
            '      generation: generation\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    sealedGyroscopeStopRejections = gyroscopeStopRejections.seal(\n'
            '      generation: generation\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    created = false\n'
            '    inFlightCount = 0\n'
            '    inFlightImageCount = 0\n'
            '    drainScheduled = false\n'
            '    // This executes on coreQueue after every in-flight native call. No later\n'
            '    // observation from the stopped epoch can append after this terminal clear.\n'
            '    poseObservationsDropped += poseObservations.count\n'
            '    poseObservations.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    if scratchCapacity > 0 {\n'
            '      scratch?.update(repeating: 0, count: scratchCapacity)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    scratch?.deallocate()\n'
            '    scratch = nil\n'
            '    scratchCapacity = 0\n'
            '    vioWidth = 0\n'
            '    vioHeight = 0\n'
            '    if state != .stopped { transitionLocked(to: .stopped) }\n'
            '    cachedSnapshot = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '    canceledStarts = startCompletions + canceledStartCompletions\n'
            '    startCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    canceledStartCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    completedStops = stopCompletions\n'
            '    stopCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '    // A terminal receipt is emitted only after the fixed ring and the single\n'
            '    // in-flight slot are empty. Conservation includes every admitted item.\n'
            '    assert(pendingCount == 0 && inFlightCount == 0)\n'
            '    assert(pendingImageCount == 0 && inFlightImageCount == 0)\n'
            '    assert(\n'
            '      queueAccepted == queueProcessedSuccess + droppedOnStop +\n'
            '        terminalRejected\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    // Freeze the old generation before a queued restart resets any field.\n'
            '    terminalReceipt = makeWireSnapshotLocked(includeRaw: false)\n'
            '    if pendingRestart == nil { lastStartRequest = nil }\n'
            '    if let pendingRestart {\n'
            '      restartRequest = pendingRestart\n'
            '      let completions = pendingRestartCompletions\n'
            '      self.pendingRestart = nil\n'
            '      pendingRestartCompletions.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)\n'
            '      let candidateEpoch = beginStartLocked(\n'
            '        pendingRestart,\n'
            '        completions: completions\n'
            '      )\n'
            '      if let candidateEpoch {\n'
            '        restartEpoch = candidateEpoch\n'
            '      } else {\n'
            '        restartRequest = nil\n'
            '        canceledStarts.append(contentsOf: completions)\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if let restartRequest, let restartEpoch {\n'
            '      // Preserve Create -> optional racing stop/drain ordering, as in start().\n'
            '      scheduleCreate(restartRequest, epoch: restartEpoch)\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '\n'
            '    DispatchQueue.main.async {\n'
            '      for completion in canceledStarts { completion(0, generation) }\n'
            '      for completion in completedStops { completion(terminalReceipt) }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func updateHealthOnCore(frameMs: Double, rawState: Int32) {\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    let frameSequence = runCalls\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    let wire: [String: Any] = [\n'
            '      "healthOverall": 0,\n'
            '      "slamState": Int(rawState),\n'
            '      "lastFrameMs": frameMs,\n'
            '      "coreHealthAvailable": 0,\n'
            '      "officialStateAvailable": 1,\n'
            '      "coreFrameSeq": frameSequence,\n'
            '    ]\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    lastHealthRc = 0\n'
            '    cachedHealth = wire\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  private func finiteWireValue(_ value: Double) -> Any {\n'
            '    value.isFinite ? value : NSNull()\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  /// Marshal one raw status observation for every processed image. No native\n'
            '  /// availability class, initialization verdict, timestamp fallback, pacing,\n'
            '  /// coordinate conversion, alignment, threshold, or error metric lives here.\n'
            '  private func observePoseAndPrepareWire(\n'
            '    frame: PendingFrame,\n'
            '    generation: UInt32,\n'
            '    rawState: Int32,\n'
            '    rawPose: PWXrslamRawPose\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    let healthRc = lastHealthRc\n'
            '    let healthWire = cachedHealth\n'
            '    let rawPreviousImageTimestamp = previousImageTimestamp\n'
            '    let rawSessionStartedAt = sessionStartedAt\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '    let observedAt = CACurrentMediaTime()\n'
            '    var observation: [String: Any] = [\n'
            '      "rawStateCallCompleted": true,\n'
            '      "rawCameraPoseCallCompleted": true,\n'
            '      "rawPoseTimestamp": finiteWireValue(rawPose.timestamp),\n'
            '      "sensorTimestamp": finiteWireValue(frame.timestamp),\n'
            '      "xrslamPoseTimestamp": finiteWireValue(rawPose.timestamp),\n'
            '      "rawHealthRc": Int(healthRc),\n'
            '      "rawXrslamState": Int(rawState),\n'
            '      "rawCoreFrameSeq": healthRc == 0\n'
            '        ? (healthWire["coreFrameSeq"] ?? NSNull()) : NSNull(),\n'
            '      "lastFrameMs": healthRc == 0\n'
            '        ? (healthWire["lastFrameMs"] ?? NSNull()) : NSNull(),\n'
            '      "previousImageTimestamp": finiteWireValue(rawPreviousImageTimestamp),\n'
            '      "enqueuedAtUptimeSeconds": finiteWireValue(frame.enqueuedAt),\n'
            '      "observedAtUptimeSeconds": finiteWireValue(observedAt),\n'
            '      "sessionStartedAtUptimeSeconds": finiteWireValue(rawSessionStartedAt),\n'
            '    ]\n'
            '\n'
            '    let t = frame.arkitWorldFromCamera\n'
            '    observation["referenceTrackingState"] = frame.referenceTrackingState\n'
            '    observation["referenceTrackingReason"] = frame.referenceTrackingReason\n'
            '    let referenceWorldFromCamera: [Double] = [\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.0.x), Double(t.columns.0.y),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.0.z), Double(t.columns.0.w),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.1.x), Double(t.columns.1.y),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.1.z), Double(t.columns.1.w),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.2.x), Double(t.columns.2.y),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.2.z), Double(t.columns.2.w),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.3.x), Double(t.columns.3.y),\n'
            '      Double(t.columns.3.z), Double(t.columns.3.w),\n'
            '    ]\n'
            '    observation["referenceWorldFromCamera"] = referenceWorldFromCamera\n'
            '    // Exact XRSLAM iOS sample -> SceneKit camera convention:\n'
            '    // position (-py, -px, -pz), rotation (-qy, -qx, -qz, qw).\n'
            '    let xrslamWorldFromCamera: [String: Any] = [\n'
            '      "qx": finiteWireValue(-rawPose.quaternion.1),\n'
            '      "qy": finiteWireValue(-rawPose.quaternion.0),\n'
            '      "qz": finiteWireValue(-rawPose.quaternion.2),\n'
            '      "qw": finiteWireValue(rawPose.quaternion.3),\n'
            '      "tx": finiteWireValue(-rawPose.translation.1),\n'
            '      "ty": finiteWireValue(-rawPose.translation.0),\n'
            '      "tz": finiteWireValue(-rawPose.translation.2),\n'
            '    ]\n'
            '    observation["xrslamPoseCoordinateConvention"] = "official_scene_kit_ios"\n'
            '    observation["xrslamWorldFromCamera"] = xrslamWorldFromCamera\n'
            '\n'
            '    lock.lock()\n'
            '    poseObservationsOffered += 1\n'
            '    guard state == .running,\n'
            '          UInt32(truncatingIfNeeded: sessionGeneration) == generation else {\n'
            '      poseObservationsDropped += 1\n'
            '      lock.unlock()\n'
            '      return\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    poseObservationSequence += 1\n'
            '    observation["seq"] = poseObservationSequence\n'
            '    poseObservations.append(observation)\n'
            '    lock.unlock()\n'
            '  }\n'

            '\n'
            '  private func generationCount(\n'

            '\n'
            '  private func makeWireSnapshotLocked(includeRaw: Bool) -> [String: Any] {\n'
            '    var out = makeCoreSnapshotLocked()\n'
            '    let imageLock = generationCount(\n'
            '      imageLockContention, sealed: sealedImageLockContention\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let accelerationLock = generationCount(\n'
            '      accelerationLockContention,\n'
            '      sealed: sealedAccelerationLockContention\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let gyroscopeLock = generationCount(\n'
            '      gyroscopeLockContention,\n'
            '      sealed: sealedGyroscopeLockContention\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let imageStop = generationCount(\n'
            '      imageStopRejections, sealed: sealedImageStopRejections\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let accelerationStop = generationCount(\n'
            '      accelerationStopRejections,\n'
            '      sealed: sealedAccelerationStopRejections\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let gyroscopeStop = generationCount(\n'
            '      gyroscopeStopRejections,\n'
            '      sealed: sealedGyroscopeStopRejections\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let images = imageFacts.wire(\n'
            '      lockContention: imageLock,\n'
            '      stopRejections: imageStop\n'
            '    )\n'
            '    let acc = accFacts.wire(\n'
            '      lockContention: accelerationLock,\n'
            '      stopRejections: accelerationStop\n'
            '    )\n'

            '      stopRejections: gyroscopeStop\n'
            '    )\n'

            '    let lockContentionTotal = imageLock + accelerationLock + gyroscopeLock\n'
            '    if lockContentionTotal > 0 {\n'
            '      invalidationReasons[\n'
            '        SensorRejectionReason.lockContention.rawValue,\n'
            '        default: 0\n'
            '      ] += lockContentionTotal\n'
            '    }\n'

            '    if lateAfterSealTotal > 0 {\n'

            '    let transportValid = !shadowRunInvalidated && lateAfterSealTotal == 0\n'
            '    out["identity"] = runIdentityLocked()\n'
            '    for (key, value) in nativeDestroyReceipt { out[key] = value }\n'
            '    out["queueAdmitted"] = queueAccepted\n'

            '    out["queueSubmitted"] = queueProcessedSuccess\n'

            '    out["transportValid"] = transportValid\n'
            '    out["shadowRunInvalidated"] = !transportValid\n'
            '    out["runInvalidationReasons"] = invalidationReasons\n'
            '    out["workConserved"] = queueAccepted == queueProcessedSuccess +\n'
            '      droppedOnStop + terminalRejected + pendingCount + inFlightCount\n'
            '    out["terminalReceiptComplete"] = state == .stopped &&\n'
            '      pendingCount == 0 && inFlightCount == 0 &&\n'
            '      pendingImageCount == 0 && inFlightImageCount == 0\n'
            '    out["shutdownDrops"] = shutdownDrops\n'
            '    out["stateTransitions"] = stateTransitions\n'
            '    out["poseObservationsOffered"] = poseObservationsOffered\n'
            '    out["poseObservationsDropped"] = poseObservationsDropped\n'
            '    out["poseObservations"] = includeRaw ? poseObservations : []\n'
            '    out["imagesAttempted"] = images.attempted\n'
            '    out["imagesSubmitted"] = images.submitted\n'
            '    out["imagesAccepted"] = images.submitted\n'
            '    out["imagesRejected"] = images.rejected\n'
            '    out["accAttempted"] = acc.attempted\n'
            '    out["accSubmitted"] = acc.submitted\n'
            '    out["accAccepted"] = acc.submitted\n'
            '    out["accRejected"] = acc.rejected\n'

            '    out["gyroSubmitted"] = gyro.submitted\n'
            '    out["gyroAccepted"] = gyro.submitted\n'
            '    out["gyroRejected"] = gyro.rejected\n'
